variant.briefing:
Hi,

Bunch of basic goods needed at [Destination] were stolen while in transit. Got a tip that the supplies were taken to [Location]. Can you head there and reclaim them for us? 

The place is allegedly abandoned, but looks can be deceiving. My advice, prepare for the worst but hope for the best. 

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a handheld tractor beam with you. 

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
